description: A notice that mentions mailing documents/paying online outside the renewal-method sentences must not get an invented 'renew online' or 'return the paper form' step — action steps require an exact supporting quote in the renewal-method lines.

input.text:
CEDAR COUNTY BENEFITS
DATE 09/20/2026
It is time to renew your benefits.
The benefits you need to renew have a check-mark next to them:
[x] SNAP
Due dates:
Return your form by 10/15/2026.
Items we need from you: send copies.
• Proof of income: last 4 pay stubs.
Mail your documents to the county office by Friday.
Pay online for office services at county.example.com.
